scope: Development study after seeing v1 holdout failures. Train partition and existing CV folds only. No validation/test/challenge scoring, gate changes, or automatic deployment.
selection: Eligible only when pooled OOF macro-F1, all-class recall, both severe-error rates, and logistic/dummy comparisons meet unchanged discrimination gates. Rank eligible candidates by mean fold macro-F1, lower log loss, then ID. Selection estimates are not release evidence.
fresh_evaluation: Freeze new independent evaluation variants before subsequent tuning; old holdouts remain consumed. Do not create a supposedly fresh holdout by reshuffling previously used rows.
